 Java United vs Persib Bandung Today: Live Score, Statistics, and Latest Match Updates
 Follow the live score of the Java United vs Persib Bandung match in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at Jatidiri Stadium, Semarang, on Sunday (11/8/2026).
 By: Damar Prasetya

 SEMARANG, Aktualita.co -  The live score of Java United vs Persib Bandung is drawing the attention of Indonesian football fans this Sunday (11/8/2026). Both teams are scheduled to meet in the ninth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at Jatidiri Stadium, Semarang, Central Java. 
 The match is scheduled to kick off at 19:00 WIB (Western Indonesian Time) or 20:00 WITA (Central Indonesian Time). This duel brings together Java United, who are enjoying a positive trend at home, and Persib Bandung, who are looking to maintain their winning momentum after appearing in Asian competition. 
 Advertisement 
 Based on checks ahead of the match, the live score for Java United vs Persib Bandung is currently listed as not yet started . Consequently, there are no goals, goalscorers, or confirmed match results yet. 
 Persib arrives as the defending champion with the ambition to improve their position in the standings. Meanwhile, Java United wants to use Jatidiri Stadium as a venue to reclaim three points. 
 Update Live Score Java United vs Persib Bandung Today 
 The match between Java United and Persib Bandung is one of the games that will influence the top-tier competition of this season's BRI Super League. 
 Here is the match information: 
 Match: Java United FC vs Persib Bandung 
 Competition: 2026/2027 BRI Super League 
 Week: Ninth 
 Date: Sunday, November 8, 2026 
 Kick-off: 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA 
 Stadium: Jatidiri, Semarang 
 Score status: Not yet started 
 Live broadcast: Indosiar 
 Live streaming: Vidio 
 As of the update before kick-off, there are no records of goals or statistics for a match already in progress. 
 Score developments must follow official data once the referee blows the whistle to start the match. Information regarding goalscorers, cards, substitutions, and final results must also be adjusted to events confirmed on the field. 
 Persib Bandung Hunts for Victory to Close in on the Top of the Standings 
 Persib Bandung enters this match with positive momentum after defeating Melbourne Victory 2-1 in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Two match on Wednesday (11/4/2026). 
 The victory ensured Maung Bandung advanced to the round of 16 of the Asian competition. This achievement also demonstrates Persib's ability to compete within a congested match schedule. 
 In domestic competition, Persib has collected 16 points from eight matches before facing Java United. A positive result in Semarang will help the Bandung-based team narrow the gap with its competitors. 
 Persib captain, Marc Klok, emphasized that his team's target remains unchanged despite having to play many matches in a short period. 
 "We want to be at the top of the standings and in the top position in any competition," said Klok ahead of the match, Saturday (11/7/2026). 
 However, the long journey after the match in Australia presents its own challenge. 
 Persib coach, Igor Tolic, revealed that his team must pay attention to the player recovery process. The duel against Java United is Persib's tenth match in a span of about 30 days. 
 This condition makes decisions regarding the starting lineup crucial to maintaining game balance. 
 Java United Undefeated in Last Five Matches 
 In the host camp, Java United also has reason to be confident. 
 Fabio Lefundes' team has recorded positive results in their last five league matches with three wins and two draws. 
 Java United previously defeated Bhayangkara FC with a score of 2-0. That victory extended their good record ahead of Persib's arrival. 
 At Jatidiri Stadium, Java United is also undefeated in four home matches with three wins and one draw. 
 Fabio Lefundes expressed his confidence in the quality of the Java United squad even though the opponent is the defending champion. 
 "I believe 100 percent, Java United has quality players to face the match and a team of Persib Bandung's caliber," said Lefundes in a press conference, Saturday (11/7/2026). 
 The Brazilian coach also does not consider the long journey made by Persib as an automatic advantage for his team. 
 According to him, the quality and depth of the Persib squad remain a serious threat that must be faced with full concentration. 
 Reunion of David da Silva and Ciro Alves Draws Attention 
 One of the interesting stories ahead of the Java United vs Persib Bandung duel is the presence of several former Maung Bandung players in the host camp. 
 David da Silva and Ciro Alves are now part of Java United. Both once played important roles in Persib's journey to achieving success in domestic competition. 
 In addition, the names Gustavo Franca and Frets Butuan further add to the connection between the two clubs. 
 The presence of these former players makes the match even more interesting because they already know the character of Persib's game. 
 David da Silva has experience as a striker capable of exploiting space in the penalty box. Meanwhile, Ciro Alves is known for his ability to build attacks through movement and passes to teammates. 
 In the Persib camp, Marc Klok remains one of the important players in maintaining midfield balance, while Luka Menalo offers attacking options from the wing area. 
 However, the involvement of each player in the match still depends on the official lineup announced before kick-off. 
 Head to Head Java United vs Persib Bandung 
 The record of meetings between the two teams shows a fairly balanced rivalry. 
 In the last four matches recorded in I.League data, each club has collected two wins. No match has ended in a draw. 
 Here are the results of the previous four meetings: 
 February 6, 2026: Persib Bandung 2-0 Java United 
 December 14, 2025: Java United 2-0 Persib Bandung 
 May 2, 2025: Java United 1-0 Persib Bandung 
 December 13, 2024: Persib Bandung 2-0 Java United 
 Interestingly, both teams have always been able to keep a clean sheet when winning in those four meetings. 
 However, past results do not always reflect current conditions. Changes in player composition, coach strategies, and match schedules can influence the course of the match. 
 Live Broadcast and Score Developments 
 The Java United vs Persib Bandung match is scheduled to be broadcast live via Indosiar and the Vidio streaming service. 
 This match has the potential to be tight. Java United has the advantage of playing at home and positive momentum, while Persib arrives with international match experience and confidence after securing a place in the knockout phase of Asian competition. 
 The midfield battle, effectiveness in finishing, and the ability of both teams to handle pressure are likely to be important factors. 
 For Persib, a win means a chance to maintain the race toward the top of the table. Meanwhile, for Java United, three points could improve their position while extending their positive record at Jatidiri Stadium. 
 The live score of Java United vs Persib Bandung will be a determinant of how the BRI Super League standings 2026/2027 develop after this ninth-week match concludes.
